description: Reproduce quest translation latency with the existing eight-checkpoint visual matrix.
prerequisites: Copied character and translation covering selected quest IDs
Repeat with Japanese and English-patched images and record their fingerprints
Normal search budget; diagnostic unlimited mode is a separate comparison

review.expect: A shop/smithy contains covered translated text as positive control.
Covered quest titles translated on first display, within one second.
Covered title, objective, failure, description, monsters and client translated on first display.
Changing star level and reopening refreshes all covered fields without delay.
Covered Hall names translated on first display without recurring stalls.
Covered Hall detail fields translated correctly and fit the layout.
After accepting and departing, the same covered quest fields remain translated in Current Quest Details.
A separate original-language run of the same quest has intact original text; record its run ID.
